guides.title: Manual step: Run and monitor SGEN
guides.warning: SGEN remains a SAP GUI activity and can run for several hours.
guides.completion_label: I started SGEN for all available components and verified that the job completed successfully.

steps.title: Start SGEN
steps.description: In client `000`, open transaction `SGEN` and choose the option to generate all relevant objects.

steps.title: Select components
steps.description: Open **Components**, select all components currently available in the system, and continue. The exact number may differ from the older screenshot in the guide.

steps.title: Start the job
steps.description: Select the generated job and choose **Start job immediately**.

steps.title: Monitor completion
steps.description: Monitor the background job and generation log, for example with `SM37`, until it finishes. Resolve critical generation errors before confirming this todo.

guides.title: Manual step: Generate and download the SAP license
guides.warning: Complete this manual step before running the license helper.
guides.completion_label: I downloaded the SAP license file and have it available for installation.

steps.title: Open SAP for Me
steps.description: Open **SAP for Me**, select **Services and Support**, and open **License Keys**.
steps.caption: Open Services and Support and License Keys.
steps.alt: SAP for Me navigation with the license-key application highlighted.

steps.title: Select the installation
steps.description: Select the authorized customer, product **SAP S/4HANA**, and the correct installation number.
steps.caption: Select the authorized installation.
steps.alt: SAP for Me installation selection form.

steps.title: Add the system
steps.description: Add the target system with version **SAP S/4HANA 2023** and choose **Training system** as the system role.
steps.caption: Choose Training system.
steps.alt: Add New System form with Training system selected.

steps.title: Generate the keys
steps.description: In SAP for Me, add **Standard - Web Application Server ABAP or ABAP+JAVA**, enter the hardware key, and generate the required keys.
steps.caption: Generate the required license keys.
steps.alt: SAP for Me license-key request form.

steps.title: Download the license file
steps.description: Select both generated keys and download the `.txt` license file. Transfer it to the server using the approved secure process and keep the remote path available for the automation.

steps.title: Remove old license key
steps.description: Open transaction `SLICENSE`, remove obsolete licenses before installing new license through automation.
steps.caption: Remove obsolete license keys.
steps.alt: SAP SLICENSE screen with the hardware-key field.

guides.title: Manual step: Import the active instance profile
guides.warning: Complete this step before the profile automation is enabled.
guides.completion_label: I imported the active-server profiles in RZ10 and reviewed the import log.

steps.title: Import active profiles
steps.description: Choose **Utilities → Import profiles → Of active servers**.

steps.title: Review the result
steps.description: Confirm that the expected profile following `<SID>_D<PAS instance number>_<hostname>` was imported. Stop and resolve serious errors before continuing.

guides.title: Manual step: Delete obsolete source-system profiles
guides.warning: Deleting the wrong profile can prevent the SAP system from starting. Complete this step before profile automation is enabled.
guides.completion_label: I removed the obsolete source-system profiles and verified the remaining profile list.

steps.title: Open the profile list
steps.description: In `RZ10`, open the profile selection list and identify profiles inherited from the export/source system.

steps.title: Delete each obsolete profile
steps.description: For each confirmed obsolete profile, choose **Profile → Delete → All versions → Of one profile**. Do not delete profiles whose ownership is unclear.

steps.title: Verify the remaining profiles
steps.description: Confirm that only `DEFAULT` and the profiles matching the current target SID and hostname remain.
